::: {.callout-note .legacy appearance="simple"}
This post is from the blog I kept as Preceptor in Mathematics at Harvard (2005–2008). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

I got my own digital camera to play with when I picked up the [Nikon Coolpix L10 5MP](http://www.amazon.com/Nikon-Coolpix-Digital-Camera-Optical/dp/B000N49WPC) on clearance (90 bucks!) at [MicroCenter](http://www.microcenter.com/).

Partly this is for an article I’m writing about Web 2.0 and all the online photoservices (Flickr, Photobucket, Facebook) that are out there. I need some photos which aren’t of my kids to demonstrate with.

But a major reason is to upload this photo which I nominate for “nerdiest pop culture reference with a Brother labelmaker”:

![](http://i203.photobucket.com/albums/aa27/leingang_math/DSCN0012.jpg){width="662" height="495" border="0"}

The reference is to *[Office Space](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0151804/)*, which makes me happy to be in academia.
